headline: Infosys, Mazagon Dock, Coal India and others announce record dates for corporate actions
hook: Upcoming record dates for fifty listed stocks
summary: Around 50 companies have scheduled corporate action record dates for the week of November 2 to November 8. This lineup includes dividend record dates for major firms like Infosys, Asian Paints, and Coal India. Additionally, Concord Biotech has set a record date for a 1:1 bonus issue on November 4, while Gujarat Natural Resources and Knowledge Marine are executing stock splits. Indian retail investors holding these shares on the record date will qualify for the respective corporate benefits.
whats_next: November 2-8 record dates for respective stocks
why_it_matters: Qualify for dividends, bonus issues or splits by holding shares in time.

headline: Concord Biotech releases investor presentation for shareholders
hook: Routine investor deck released by Concord
summary: Concord Biotech has submitted its latest investor presentation to the stock exchanges. The company routinely files such presentations to update stakeholders on its business segments, operational performance, and strategic outlook. Shareholders and analysts can review the document to gauge the company's current standing. Retail investors can track these disclosures for official updates on corporate progress.
why_it_matters: Official strategic updates help track company progress.

headline: Concord Biotech announces issuance of bonus equity shares
summary: Concord Biotech has announced plans to issue bonus equity shares to its shareholders. The company made this announcement through regulatory filings. Details regarding the bonus ratio and record date are yet to be fully detailed in standard disclosures. Shareholders of the company stand to receive additional shares without any extra cash outflow.
whats_next: Announcement of the bonus share record date and ratio
why_it_matters: Existing shareholders receive extra shares, increasing overall liquidity.
winners_losers: Concord Biotech shareholders gain / none hurt

headline: Concord Biotech fixes November 4 as record date for bonus shares
summary: Concord Biotech has notified the stock exchanges that November 4, 2026, will serve as the record date for determining shareholders eligible for its upcoming bonus issue. Eligible retail investors holding shares as of this date will receive additional shares as per the announced ratio. Corporate actions like bonus issues increase equity liquidity but adjust stock prices proportionally. Indian retail shareholders holding the stock in their demat accounts on the record date will automatically participate.
why_it_matters: Eligible shareholders receive bonus shares automatically in demat accounts.
